First release of ExcaliTotum, an independent fork of ExcaliDash 0.6.7.

- The project, repository and container images are renamed: pull `ghcr.io/stavarengo/excalitotum-backend` and `ghcr.io/stavarengo/excalitotum-frontend`.
- Environment variables, browser storage keys and the `.excalidash` backup format are unchanged, so an existing ExcaliDash deployment and its backups keep working after switching images.
- The in-app update check now follows this repository's releases.
